invariants: Reader pins come from explicit host context, never adopted by opening data.

Signed submissions are checked against the order and recognized policy; pure review never stores evidence.
Explicit host admission uses an exact journal-head transaction and cannot approve or commit a target effect.
Views and API/CLI share recomputed T3 decisions. Imported receipts remain unverified until exact replay.
User text is data; input cannot name an import path, execute, sign, fetch, update policy or perform an effect.
Only installed trusted handlers run; SDK validation/fixture qualification is not sandboxing or independent certification.
Collectors are explicit host calls with closed resource scope, bounded reads, no write fallback, and no implied observation authority.
HTTP is exact-host/exact-URL, no ambient proxy/redirect/credentials; local HTTP permitted only explicitly for loopback tests.
Repository/release/deployment/job captures check declared snapshot correspondence, not live global discovery.
Workspace export requires separate host preview/approval, immutable bytes, expiration and create-only installation.
GUI cancellation discards old results, one worker only; it does not terminate arbitrary host code.
Native integrations are qualified by exact available material. P/PPI/UCM remain unbound absent actual selected validators/hosts.
T1/T2/T3 runtime, program freeze and accepted corpora remain byte-identical.
Incomplete native gates remain blocked; neither software tests nor UI prove productivity or independent review.
